## In preparation

Twelve manuscripts are in the writing phase, four of them as first author:

- Long-term effects of macrophyte removal on aquatic biodiversity in rivers and lakes
- Influence of wetland restoration and alteration on GHG emissions across wetland types:
  a meta-analysis
- Current knowledge on the impact of coastal wetland restoration on biodiversity:
  insights from a meta-analysis
- A continuous trait-based framework for aquatic macrophyte life forms: the
  emergent–floating–submerged (EFS) continuum *(co-author)*
